title: Cold rebuild: move a whole stack
summary: Rebase a stack of three branches onto a new main in one command, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Stacked branches* you moved a stack of three pull request branches onto a new `main` with one rebase. Now do it
again from memory: the same scenario, **no hints, no solution to peek at**. The checks are the ones you passed before.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Which branch do you run the stack rebase from?
options: The top branch of the stack, so every lower branch is inside the rebased range
The bottom branch, because the others build on it
Any of them: Git finds the stack by itself
steps.explain: `--update-refs` moves branches that point **into** the commits being rebased. From the top, all of them are.

steps.title: Move the whole stack, cold
prompt: `~/shop`: the stack `stack/1-model` → `stack/2-api` → `stack/3-ui` hangs off an old `main`. Put all three on the new `main` with one rebase, each keeping its own commits.
From memory: no hints this time.
